author_decisions: 2026-10-17: Test houses as simple exterior blocks; each front door enters a separate map containing only that house's interior.
Soldiers remain present and interactable inside before the siege, preserving individual state when they emerge from their house doors.

2026-10-17: Preserve every house's existing position, exterior width, depth and roof height. Keep street widths, lots and public routes unchanged; only the interior representation and door connection may change.
Shops retain their existing layout and receive distinctive nineteenth-century signs matching their existing merchandise categories.
Keep the existing unloaded-hub clock policy: unloaded maps do not simulate combat; a due siege starts on return to MAP06.

2026-10-17: Compare these separate interiors against the same city with house walls extended upward to block overhead visibility. This is an isolated diagnostic; production keeps its original roof height pending the comparison and author review.
